asked.item: Fix My Automation button missing on failed request in Logs
Is the button hidden on my plan

verdict.reason: The pages say Fix My Automation is n8n only and doesn't work for Make.com, and they point to the manual checklist instead.

steps.text: The Fix My Automation feature is n8n only, and it does not work for Make.com.
For Make.com, use the manual troubleshooting checklist. It starts with checking your Blotato API key, Account IDs, and Page/channel IDs.
In the Logs, you can click any request to see the full payload, error response, and which account it was sent to.
